subject: Mitochondrial superoxide: a developmental signal that preserves nuclear envelope integrity
script: From Agewell Brief: Mitochondrial superoxide: a developmental signal that preserves nuclear envelope integrity. A new study reveals that a burst of mitochondrial superoxide during development programs long-term nuclear envelope health by curbing unsaturated fat synthesis and lipid peroxidation. Reduced ETC activity preserves nuclear envelope morphology in aging worms. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
